title: Identifiability from Moments in Independent Component Analysis Mixture Models
summary: We study Independent Component Analysis (ICA) mixture models. These models consist of mixtures of ICA densities. An ICA density is associated with a random vector whose coordinates become mutually independent after an invertible linear transformation. ICA mixture models are nonparametric extensions of the celebrated family of Gaussian mixtures. We show that in many cases the ICA mixtures are identifiable from the collection of the observed moment tensors, that is, the mixing coefficients, linear transformations, and source moments of order up to $d$ can be identified from the moment tensors…
